items.title: The One Thing Every AI Agent Framework Agrees On - Mislav Ivanda, Daytona
items.summary: Mislav Ivanda of Daytona has integrated sandboxes into most of the major agent frameworks, and noticed that frameworks that disagree on almost everything all ended up in the same place. He compares three ways to run agent-generated code: allow lists and approval prompts, embedded runtimes, and a separate sandboxed computer. He explains why only the last one keeps a compromised step from compromising your app, and shows frameworks like CrewAI, AG2 and the OpenAI Agents SDK moving to sandboxes. His advice: models, prompts and even frameworks are easy to swap, so choose where your agent's code runs before you choose a framework. Chapters: 0:00 Intro 0:52 Guess the framework 2:20 Frameworks that agree on nothing 3:42 Where should agent code run? 4:12 Option 1: allow lists and approvals 5:23 Option 2: embedded runtimes 6:46 Option 3: a separate computer 7:54 Frameworks are moving to sandboxes 9:19 How sandbox use has changed 10:33 Which framework should I pick? 12:46 The one choice you can't easily swap 14:09 Frameworks are opinions, boundaries are commitments Mislav Ivanda https://www.daytona.io Join us in SF for the second annual AIE CODE summit: https://aie.codes our last flagship summit of 2026. Applications live now!

items.title: Your Coding Agent Knows Your Code, But Not Your Actual App (Here's the Fix)
items.summary: Your coding agent can read every file in your repo and still not really know your app - how the data connects, what depends on what, where it's deployed, or why it broke last night. All of that lives in the platforms your app runs on, not in the code, so what you need is one place where your agent can see the whole app and work with all of it. With OutSystems MCP, any coding agent like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot can plug into OutSystems Developer Cloud, so your agent can look up your real entities, screens, logic and roles, map dependencies, hand the build to Mentor, deploy, and read logs and traces, all from one session. It runs with the same permissions you already have in OutSystems. Personal Edition is free and has OutSystems MCP turned on. Try OutSystems MCP with your coding agent: https://fandf.co/4z8d4HY Thanks to OutSystems for working with me on this!
